meta.title: About AfghanUstad
meta.description: AfghanUstad is a learning platform for computer and technology skills, built around clear explanations, hands-on practice and your own language.

hero.title: Technology in your language, learn by building.
hero.description: AfghanUstad is a learning platform for computer and technology skills, made for Afghan learners. We explain clearly, practice constantly, and move one step at a time.

visual.ariaLabel: An abstract learning path rising through a geometric arch, with a checklist that moves from understanding to practice to building.

story.title: Why AfghanUstad exists
story.quote: Learning technology shouldn't mean learning a new language first.
story.p1: Technology opens doors, but too often it arrives in a language learners don't use at home, explained through jargon, and taught by watching instead of doing.
story.p2: AfghanUstad began from a simple belief: people learn technology best when it is explained in words they know and practiced with their own hands.
story.p3: So every lesson is written to be understood first. Every idea is followed by something to try. And every learner is trusted to move at the pace that works for them.
story.note: Clear language. Real practice. Steady progress.

approach.title: How we think about learning
approach.description: Four beliefs shape every lesson on AfghanUstad.

understanding.title: Understanding comes first
understanding.statement: If you know why something works, you can use it anywhere.
understanding.detail: We explain the reasoning behind every concept before asking you to apply it, so skills carry over to new problems instead of staying tied to one tutorial.
understanding.example: A short explanation, a worked example, then your turn.

practice.title: Practice is the lesson
practice.statement: You don't learn to use a computer by watching someone else use it.
practice.detail: Exercises sit inside each topic, not after it. Mistakes are part of the process, and every attempt moves you forward.
practice.example: Each topic ends with something you do, not something you read.

steps.title: Small steps, real progress
steps.statement: Big skills are built from small, finished steps.
steps.detail: Lessons are cut into short, clear pieces, so you always know what you are learning now and what comes next.
steps.example: One idea per step, and a clear sense of where you are.

language.title: Your language, your pace
language.statement: Learning is faster when language isn't the obstacle.
language.detail: Lessons are available in English, Dari and Pashto, and nobody is rushed. You can return to any step as often as you need.
language.example: Switch language any time; the lesson stays the same.

focus.title: Everyday skills first, then deeper ones.
focus.description: Our courses grow from the basics of using a computer to programming and web development.

fundamentals.title: Computer fundamentals
fundamentals.description: Files, the internet, email and the everyday skills everything else builds on.

programming.title: Programming
programming.description: Thinking in logic and writing real programs, step by step.

web.description: Building pages and tools that people can open and use.

loop.title: Learning and practice are one loop
loop.description: Learning is not a straight line, it's a loop. Each step feeds the next.
loop.returnLabel: Then back to learning, with more confidence
